verses.text: A prayer of someone who is suffering and worn out, as he pours out his troubles to the LORD. LORD, hear my prayer! Let my cry for help come to you.
Do not hide your face from me when I am in trouble. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly when I call.
My days disappear like smoke. My bones burn like glowing coals.
My heart is crushed and dried up like grass. I even forget to eat.
Because of my loud groaning, I am nothing but skin and bones.
I am like a desert owl, like an owl living among ruins.
I lie awake. I am like a lonely bird on a roof.
My enemies insult me all day long. Those who make fun of me use my name as a curse.
I eat ashes as my food and mix my drinks with tears
because of your great anger, because you picked me up and threw me away.
My days are like the evening shadow that fades away. I dry up like grass.
But you, LORD, sit on your throne forever. Your fame lasts for all generations.
You will get up and show mercy to Zion. It is time to be kind to her. The time you set has come.
Your servants love even the stones of her ruins. They feel sorry for her dust.
The nations will respect the name of the LORD. All the kings of the earth will respect your glory.
The LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
He will answer the prayer of those who have nothing. He will not ignore their prayer.
Let this be written down for the next generation, so people not yet born will praise the LORD.
Tell them the LORD looked down from his holy place on high. From heaven he looked at the earth
to hear the groans of the prisoners and to set free those sentenced to death.
Then people will talk about the name of the LORD in Zion and praise him in Jerusalem,
when the nations and kingdoms gather together to serve the LORD.
In the middle of my life he took away my strength. He cut my life short.
So I said, "My God, do not take me away in the middle of my life. Your years go on through all generations.
Long ago you laid the foundations of the earth. The skies are the work of your hands.
They will disappear, but you will remain. They will all wear out like clothes. You will change them like a coat, and they will be thrown away.
But you stay the same. Your years will never end.
The children of your servants will live in safety. Their descendants will be secure in your presence."
